agents.name: Check a sitemap sample for broken links
agents.description: Finds broken or redirected pages in a sitemap sample. Use it when the user asks whether pages of an online store or website are broken or redirected, or for a broken link in the sitemap, for example "are any pages of shop.example.com broken?", "check my sitemap for 404s" or "do my product pages redirect?". Pass the domain. Reads the sitemap (for a sitemap index, the product, page, collection and blog sitemaps first) and checks up to 40 addresses spread across it, on that host only, returning counts by status, and for each broken, unreachable or redirected address its status and final address. It is a sample, not every page; it uses HEAD requests at low concurrency, skips addresses that robots.txt disallows for Agent Tools, and makes at most 46 requests. Do not use it for private or local addresses, to read page content, or to monitor a site over time.

agents.name: check_links
agents.description: Check every link on a page and report which are broken. Each anchor is resolved to an absolute URL, de-duplicated, and checked with a HEAD request (falling back to GET where the server rejects HEAD), returning its status code, whether it redirected, response time and a severity. Gives a 0-100 score and a letter grade per page. Anchors, mailto: and tel: links are excluded because they cannot be broken. Up to 5 pages and 40 link checks per call. Paid: $0.02 per call in USDC on Base via x402 — call once without x_payment to receive the payment challenge.
reasons: This tool checks every link on a page and reports which are broken, directly fulfilling the user's request to find broken links on a website.
